header: Paid extras on top of a plan
subheader: The same list as rows or as a card grid
lead: Each add-on shows its name, its price and one line on what it does. The style changes only the surface.
note: The note holds the terms for all extras: how they are billed and what happens when one is cancelled.

addons.title: The name is a heading
addons.text: Each add-on is a level-three heading in the page outline.

addons.title: The price keeps its own column
addons.text: In the list style, prices sit at the end of each row, so you can scan them straight down.

addons.title: One line says what it does
addons.text: More than one line makes the list hard to scan.

addons.title: Cards stretch to their row
addons.text: So the prices line up, however long the text below them is.
